Temblar de la mano al tiritar
Whether to shake the player's hand in first person when cold.
yacl3.config.frostiful:client/display.di: Desactivar textura de oso polar dañado
When Polar Bears have been recently brushed, they show a hurt skin. Disable this feature if the texture is not compatible with your resource pack.
yacl3.config.frostiful:client/display.en: Mostrar partículas de goteo de agua al estar mojado
Toggles the water drip particles when wet. Has no effect if Scorchful is installed.
Toggle the frosty heart temperature display on the health bar.
yacl3.config.frostiful:client/display.re: Frosty camera overlay temperature scale start
The temperature scale below which the frosty camera overlay will begin to appear. Must be between -1 and 0 (inclusive).
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/block.camp: Multiplies the range of the Warmth effect applied to entities around a Campfire, after adding a log. The base range is 10 blocks. Must be at least 0.
Multiplies the duration of the Warmth effect that will be applied to entities near a campfire when a log is added to it. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/block.desc: Server-side settings that relate to blocks.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/block.enab: When enabled, icicles hanging from a ceiling will have a chance to become unstable and fall.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/block.icic: Multiplies the chance that an icicle hanging from a ceiling will attempt to grow. Must be at least 0.
If icicle instability is enabled, multiplies the chance that an icicle hanging from a ceiling will become unstable and fall. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/block.sunL: Multiplies the duration that a Hot Sun Lichen will burn a warm entity that touches it. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/entity.chi: Multiplicador de daño por fuego al Escarchador
Multiplies all incoming Fire-based damage applied to Chillagers.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/entity.des: Server-side settings that relate to entities and mobs.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/entity.ena: When enabled, Pillagers are replaced by Chillagers when Patrols spawn in snowy areas.
La nieve se compacta con entidades pesadas
When enabled, heavy mobs like Iron Golems and Ravagers will compact the snow they walk on, turning it to Packed Snow.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/entity.fro: Controls the amplifier of the Frost Bite effect applied by Biters. When set to automatic, the amplifier scales with world difficulty (0 in easy, 1 in normal, 3 in hard). Otherwise, locks the amplifier to the chosen difficulty's value regardless of world difficulty. Note that peaceful is not allowed, as it would have no effect.
Multiplicador de daño por fuego al Frostólogo
Multiplies all incoming Fire-based damage applied to Frostologers.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/entity.str: When enabled, Strays will fire Glacial Arrows instead of Slowness arrows. Strays will drop both Slowness and Glacial arrows regardless of what this option is set to.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/environmen: Environment Settings
Shivering
Temperature values
Degrees Celsius per temperature level decrease
How many degrees Celsius per temperature level decrease. Smaller numbers makes colder areas freeze players faster. Must be positive.
Server-side settings for environment simulation.
Habilitar congelamiento pasivo (global)

When enabled, players will receive environmental temperature reductions from exposure in cold biomes. This can also be toggled on a per-world basis with the game rule frostiful:enable_environment_freezing.
Environment freezing soaked multiplier
Multiples the temperature reduction per tick of entities that are wet. Must be at least 0.
Intervalo de ticks del congelamiento pasivo
The interval, in ticks, between applications of environmental freezing to players. Must be at least 0.
Environment temperature multiplier
Multiplies the temperature point reduction from environmental freezing.
Temperatura máxima para frío (en °C)
The maximum temperature that can be cold, in Celsius. May not exceed 15°C.
Minimum environmental freezing temperature scale
The minimum temperature scale to which environmental freezing will cool a player. Must be between -1 and 0 (inclusive)
Nivel mínimo de luz de bloque para generar calor
The minimum block light level that is considered to be well-lit and warm. Must be at least 0.
Shiver below temperature change
The temperature scale below which entities will begin to shiver. Must be between -1 and 0 (inclusive).
Shivering warming minimum food level
When a player is below this food level, the player will stop consuming hunger and stop being warmed by shivering to prevent starvation. Must be between 0 and 20 (inclusive).
Shivering warmth multiplier
Multiplies the heating applied each tick to entities that are shivering. Note that the hunger cost of shivering also scales with this multiplier. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.desc: Server-side settings that relate to items.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.enabl: When enabled, icicles will be able to be thrown.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.frost: Multiplies the cooldown time of the Frost Wand after casting a spell. Must be at least 0.
Multiplies the time that an entity struck by a Frost Wand is rooted in place. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.maxFr: Multiplies the maximum distance (in blocks) that a spell fired from a Frost Wand can travel before exploding. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.packe: Daño de bola de nieve compacta
How much damage a Packed Snowball applies to targets. Must be at least 0.
Daño extra a tipos vulnerables de bola de nieve compacta
How much damage a Packed Snowball applies to a target that is a vulnerable type (Strider, Blaze, Magma Cube) when hit. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.skate: Probabilidad de generar mejora de patines en iglús (0-1)
The chance of an Ice Skate Upgrade Template generating in an Igloo chest. Must be between 0 and 1 (inclusive). Requires a restart after changing!
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.throw: The damage a thrown Icicle applies to targets. Must be at least 0.
How much damage a thrown Icicle applies to a target that is a vulnerable type (Strider, Blaze, Magma Cube) when hit. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.warmi: Multiplies the duration of the Warmth mob effect applied to entities after consuming food items that belong to the item tag #frostiful:warm_foods
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/soaking.en: When enabled, entities will be able to be dried from being the presence of block light. The strength of the drying increases linearly with the block light level. Has no effect if Scorchful is loaded.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/soaking.ma: Máximo de ticks de acumulación de nieve
The maximum number of ticks to record players standing in snow for the purposes of soaking them after it melts. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/soaking.on: Rate at which to decrease soaking points per tick to entities on fire. Must be at least 0. Has no effect if Scorchful is loaded.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/soaking.ra: Multiplies the soaking change per tick applied to entities standing in the rain. Must be at least 0. Has no effect if Scorchful is loaded.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/soaking.re: Remove environment frost resistance when wet
When enabled, environment frost resistance will be set to 0 for players that are wet.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/soaking.sp: Multiplies the soaking change applied to entities struck by a splash potion. The base soaking change will be 50% of the affected player's maximum wet ticks. Must be at least 0. Has no effect if Scorchful is loaded.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/soaking.to: Standing in water soaking change multiplier
Multiplies the soaking change per tick applied to entities standing in water. Must be at least 0. Has no effect if Scorchful is loaded.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/temperatur: Multiplies the heating applied each tick to underwater entities with the Conduit Power effect.
Multiplies the final temperature point change of all non-environment cooling sources like powder snow and glacial arrows.
Multiplies the cooling applied to entities that collide with Freezing Wind.
Frostologer Heat Drain temperature change multiplier
Multiplies the number of temperature points the Frostologer removes from nearby entities each tick when casting their Blizzard spell.
Multiplies the cooling applied to a target struck by a Glacial Arrow.
Multiplies the final temperature point change of all non-environment heating sources like fire and sun lichen.
Multiplies the heating applied each tick to entities that are standing on hot floor blocks like Magma.
Multiplies the cooling applied to a target that falls on an icicle or is struck by a falling icicle.
Multiplies the heating applied each tick to entities standing in an area with high artificial/block light.
Multiplies the heating applied each tick to entities that are on fire.
Multiplies cooling applied by a Packed Snowball to a target when hit.
Multiplies the cooling applied to entities in powder snow each tick.
Multiplies the heating applied to entities that touch Sun Lichen.
Multiplies the cooling applied to a target struck by a Thrown Icicle.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/weather.en: When enabled, allows freezing winds to appear high up in the air.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/weather.fr: When enabled, freezing winds will destroy exposed fire blocks (includes torches!).
Sets how freezing winds should spawn. Points create small one-off explosions of wind, entity creates an entity that rolls across the landscape, and none disables the feature entirely.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/weather.ic: Los carámbanos se forman con el clima
When enabled, icicles will form on the underside of full-face blocks near the surface of the world during weather.
